verdict.rationale: AIMA is Portugal's immigration agency, a government public-service body rather than a data-hosting or SaaS product. Letting users choose a data-storage region is not a fair axis for this kind of product, so the story does not apply. The only evidence is a failed TLS probe of the agency's site, which says nothing about data residency in either direction.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
